landmarks.name: 80-inch qualifying width
landmarks.verification_evidence: The driver of any truck or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, which is following a truck, or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, shall, whenever conditions permit, leave a space of 500 feet so that an overtaking vehicle may enter and occupy such space without danger, but this shall not prevent a truck or combination of vehicles from overtaking and passing any vehicle or combination of vehicles. This subsection does not apply to any vehicle or combination of vehicles while moving on a highway on which there are two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction.

limitations: No CARLA execution: spawn inventory, road import, collision/departure, controller tracking and camera visibility unverified.
Mandatory raw atom streams are implemented only for direct telemetry; remaining atom projections require completion against retained original-frame PipelineCapture evidence.
Primary encoded review videos are not implemented; runner saves four synchronized original RGB PNG sequences and exact frame map.
Truck blueprint dimensions and goods-transport classification require queried inventory; width-gating code refuses sub-80-inch actors.
80-inch width boundary probes cannot yet select physically matched blueprints without altering other dimensions.
Conditions permit and entering without danger remain unresolved; no timing bound for overtaking is inferred from summary.
